closure.law: Exact byte capture establishes custody only. No unit identity, event class, chronology, substantive outcome, recommendation, authority, remedy, evidence admission, or residual-class closure follows from a successful HTTP capture alone.

selection_rules: requested host must not be search.usa.gov
final host must match requested host after optional www removal
known anomalous cross-domain redirects are refused
initial body hash must be present and byte count must be 1..5 MiB
